description: Celosome X-Shape is a large-volume cross-linked hyaluronic acid body filler from South Korea, supplied in a 1 x 10 mL prefilled syringe for facial and body augmentation. The gel is non-animal-derived and ultra-purified, formulated for durable projection and contouring in deep planes. It belongs to the Celosome HA series, which is positioned around high-purity, high-cohesivity gels.
howItWorks: The cohesive cross-linked HA gel is implanted into deep tissue planes where it occupies volume, restores projection, and re-establishes contour. It binds water and integrates with surrounding tissue to maintain shape, and because it is HA-based it can be dissolved with hyaluronidase if correction is required.
composition: Cross-linked, non-animal, ultra-purified hyaluronic acid gel (Celosome line stated up to ~24 mg/mL); formulation includes lidocaine per distributor labelling; 1 x 10 mL prefilled syringe. Exact HA mg/mL for the X-Shape SKU not published.
usageNotes: For deep-plane implantation (subcutaneous/supraperiosteal or deeper as indicated) using blunt cannula technique under strict asepsis. Large-volume body contouring is best delivered in staged sessions with conservative per-visit volumes. Being HA, it remains reversible with hyaluronidase; keep hyaluronidase available for vascular or overcorrection events.
features: 10 mL syringe format suited to large-volume work
Positioned within the multi-viscosity Celosome series
benefits: Single high-capacity syringe reduces unit handling per session
Cohesive gel supports predictable moulding and projection
HA chemistry allows reversibility with hyaluronidase
Non-surgical alternative for volume and contour restoration
Consistent Korean-manufactured HA supply for clinic catalogues
indications: Correction of body volume deficits and asymmetry

description: Beads Max is a Korean large-volume body filler built on cross-linked hyaluronic acid at 20 mg/mL with a 3-staged microbead crosslinking technology for enhanced viscosity and shape hold. It is supplied in a 10 mL syringe and offered in Classic-H (firm/structural) and Classic-S (soft) variants for different depths and target areas. It is attributed to Maxcore Global Co., Ltd. (South Korea).
howItWorks: The highly hydrophilic, cross-linked HA gel is placed into deep planes to add bulk, projection, and contour. The 3-staged microbead structure raises viscosity so the implant resists deformation and migration, holding shape as it integrates with surrounding tissue; as an HA gel it is reversible with hyaluronidase.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid 20 mg/mL with 3-staged microbead (multi-crosslink) technology; 1 x 10 mL syringe. Classic-H variant is lidocaine-free; the soft Classic-S variant targets softer tissue augmentation.
usageNotes: Deliver into deep subcutaneous or intramuscular planes as appropriate to the region, using cannula technique and strict aseptic conditions. Reserve firmer Classic-H for structural, high-projection areas and softer Classic-S for breast/buttock softness. Stage large volumes across sessions and keep hyaluronidase available for the HA gel.
benefits: Two viscosities let clinics match plane and tissue type
High shape retention supports predictable contouring
Reversible HA chemistry for safety management
Non-surgical route to significant volume gain
Standardised 10 mL format simplifies procurement
indications: Correction of body asymmetry and volume loss

description: DeneB is a Korean cross-linked hyaluronic acid body filler from BioPlus Co., Ltd., supplied in a 10 mL syringe at 20 mg/mL for non-surgical body contouring and augmentation. It uses a monophasic hard gel with proprietary multi-crosslinking (MDM/MCL) technology for high cohesivity and shape retention. The standard variant includes lidocaine to reduce injection discomfort.
howItWorks: The high-viscosity monophasic HA gel is implanted in deep planes to create projection and rebuild contour, occupying tissue space and binding water for volume. Its cohesive, cross-linked network resists migration and holds form as it integrates with surrounding tissue, and it remains reversible with hyaluronidase.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid (sodium hyaluronate) 20 mg/mL, monophasic hard gel; standard SKU contains lidocaine (approx. 0.3%) for comfort; 1 x 10 mL prefilled syringe.
usageNotes: Implant into deep subcutaneous or supraperiosteal/intramuscular planes per region using cannula technique under strict asepsis. Large body areas may require substantial cumulative volume, so stage across sessions and titrate conservatively. Keep hyaluronidase on hand given the HA base; manage vascular risk with aspiration/cannula discipline.
features: 20 mg/mL cross-linked HA, monophasic hard gel
benefits: Firm gel supports strong projection and defined contour
Low-migration behaviour aids predictable moulding
Reversible with hyaluronidase for safety
Non-surgical augmentation option for clinics
CE-referenced Korean supply for catalogue listing

It suits clinics that prefer to control local anaesthesia separately or treat patients with lidocaine sensitivity.

composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid (sodium hyaluronate) 20 mg/mL, monophasic hard gel, lidocaine-free; 1 x 10 mL prefilled syringe.

features: 20 mg/mL cross-linked HA, monophasic hard gel
benefits: Suitable for lidocaine-sensitive patients
Lets clinicians control anaesthesia protocol independently
Firm gel supports strong projection and contour
Reversible with hyaluronidase for safety
Same product platform as the lidocaine variant

description: Richesse B is a Korean 100% cross-linked, non-animal hyaluronic acid body and face filler at 24 mg/mL, supplied in a 10 mL syringe for deep folds and body augmentation. The Non-Lidocaine presentation omits the anaesthetic offered in the standard 0.3% lidocaine version. It is a sterile, transparent, pyrogen-free viscoelastic gel distributed from South Korea.
howItWorks: The high-concentration cross-linked HA gel is implanted in deep planes to add volume and re-establish contour, occupying tissue space and binding water for projection. Its cohesive, fully cross-linked structure resists rapid breakdown so it holds shape as it integrates with tissue, and it remains reversible with hyaluronidase.
composition: 100% cross-linked non-animal hyaluronic acid 24 mg/mL, lidocaine-free (a separate 0.3% lidocaine version is also marketed); sterile, transparent, pyrogen-free viscoelastic gel; 1 x 10 mL syringe.
usageNotes: Implant into deep subcutaneous or intramuscular planes as indicated, using cannula technique under strict asepsis; arrange separate anaesthesia because this SKU contains no lidocaine. Stage large volumes over multiple sessions and keep hyaluronidase available given the HA base.
benefits: High HA concentration for strong volumising per unit
Lidocaine-free option for sensitive patients

description: Regenovue Glam is the body-contouring HA filler in CHA Meditech's Regenovue range, supplied in a 10 mL syringe of cross-linked, non-animal hyaluronic acid for large-area augmentation. It features uniform HA particle size, strong viscosity, and high cohesivity for precise moulding and smooth extrusion. It is CE-referenced and formulated specifically for body rather than fine facial use.
howItWorks: The cohesive, high-viscosity HA gel is implanted in deep planes where it adds volume and projection and re-establishes contour. Its uniform particle size and slow disintegration support shape retention and resistance to migration as it integrates with tissue; being HA, it is reversible with hyaluronidase.
composition: Cross-linked, non-animal hyaluronic acid (Regenovue body line stated around 24 mg/mL); uniform particle size, high-cohesivity gel; 1 x 10 mL syringe. Lidocaine content not confirmed for this SKU.
usageNotes: Implant into deep subcutaneous/supraperiosteal or intramuscular planes per region with cannula technique under strict asepsis. Store at 2-25 C. Stage large-volume body augmentation across sessions and keep hyaluronidase available for the HA gel.
features: Uniform HA particle size for smooth injection
benefits: Uniform particles support precise, smooth moulding
Low-migration behaviour aids predictable contour
Reversible with hyaluronidase for safety
From an established CHA Meditech filler brand
Efficient volumising per unit for large areas

It is offered in Hard and Soft types for contouring versus soft volumising, and uses a patented stabilisation technique to preserve the cross-linked HA network and viscoelasticity. It is attributed to DKMC Korea Co., Ltd.
howItWorks: The monophasic cross-linked HA gel is implanted in deep planes to add substantial bulk, projection, and contour. Its stabilised, entangled HA network resists breakdown and migration so the implant holds shape and integrates with tissue over time; as an HA gel it is reversible with hyaluronidase.
composition: Monophasic cross-linked hyaluronic acid 20 mg/mL; 1 x 55 mL prefilled syringe; Hard and Soft types. Lidocaine content not specified.
usageNotes: Deliver into deep subcutaneous or intramuscular planes with cannula technique under strict asepsis. The 55 mL format is intended for large-volume augmentation; still stage total volume across sessions and titrate conservatively. Reserve Hard type for structural contour and Soft type for softer volumising, and keep hyaluronidase available.
features: Designed for body contouring and replenishment
benefits: High-capacity syringe reduces handling for large areas

Cost-efficient large-volume unit for clinics
